litelights.option.far_terrain.enabled.de: Draws land you have visited far past the render distance, made from the chunks this game has already received. Nothing is generated and nothing is asked of the server. Kept per world in single player (inside the save) and per server in multiplayer, so it is there again next time.
litelights.option.far_terrain.distance.d: How far far terrain reaches. Further needs more video memory and more time to fill in after joining.
litelights.option.far_terrain.detail.des: How far out land stays at full block detail before it is drawn coarser. Higher keeps more detail further out and needs more video memory and drawing time.
litelights.option.far_terrain.video_memo: The most video memory far terrain's shapes may take. Auto follows the distance: 256 MB at 4 km, 512 MB at 8 km. When it is full, the land you haven't looked toward for longest is let go first.
litelights.option.far_terrain.threads.de: How many background threads build far terrain's shapes, beside the one that stores it. Auto is a quarter of the processor's threads, one to four. Takes effect when far terrain next starts (on joining a world or changing dimension).
litelights.option.far_terrain.lights.des: At night, lights far away (villages, lava, lit caves) glow as soft points, so you see them at any distance. Off, far lights show only as the light on the blocks around them.
litelights.option.far_terrain.water_look: How far water is drawn. Full is the near water carried on: its colour and depth, the sea floor through shallow water, reflections of the land and the sky. Plain is a flat colour by depth with the sky's sheen at low angles, and costs a little less. Both take their colours from the Water page and blend into the near water at the render distance.
litelights.option.far_terrain.stored.des: How much far terrain is stored for this world and dimension: its tiles and their size on disk.
litelights.option.far_terrain.video_in_u: The video memory far terrain's shapes take now, within the Video memory row's limit.
litelights.option.far_terrain.clear.desc: Deletes the far terrain stored for this world and dimension. It is made again as you travel.
litelights.option.far_terrain.seed_gener: Shows land you haven't visited yet, worked out on this computer from the world's seed with the game's own terrain maths: hills, seas, rivers, biomes and their colours, and stand-in trees. No chunk is generated and nothing is asked of the server. Land you visit always replaces it. In single player the world's own seed is used; on a server, the seed from LiteLights on the server, one you enter below, or the reply to /seed if you may run it. Uses the Background threads row's threads, and in single player slows down whenever the game's own server is busy.
How much land seed generation has predicted for this world and dimension: the ground it covers this session (every level counted), its size on disk, and whether it is still adding more.
No seed for this server: enter it below, or run /seed if the server lets you

litelights.option.far_terrain.seed.descr: Where the seed comes from. The seed itself is never shown or written to the log.
litelights.option.far_terrain.seed_entry: Enter the seed of the server you are on, kept for this server only. Running /seed on a server that lets you does the same. In single player the world's own seed is used and this does nothing.
litelights.option.far_terrain.clear_pred: Deletes the land seed generation predicted for this world and dimension, and predicts it again. Visited land is kept.
litelights.seed_notice.title: Far terrain from the seed
litelights.seed_notice.unchecked: This server's world-generation mods and data packs can't be checked from here, so land worked out from the seed may not match what the server generates.
litelights.seed_notice.differs: Land worked out from the seed may not match this server's: %s.
litelights.seed_notice.seed_right: The seed is this world's: it matches the one the server sent.
litelights.seed_notice.seed_wrong: This seed isn't the one this world was made with, so the land will come out wrong. You can enter another on the Far Terrain page.
litelights.seed_notice.biomes_missing: The server has biomes this game hasn't (from %s), so its land is made with mods or data packs that aren't installed here.
litelights.seed_notice.ask: Generate anyway? Land you visit always replaces what was predicted.
litelights.seed_notice.always: Don't ask again for this server
litelights.seed_entry.title: This server's seed
litelights.seed_entry.help: Enter the world's seed as a number (the one /seed shows). It is kept for this server only, never shown again and never written to the log.
litelights.seed_entry.help_saved: A seed is kept for this server. Enter another to replace it, or forget it.
litelights.seed_entry.not_a_number: That isn't a whole number seed.
litelights.seed_generation.captured: LiteLights kept this server's seed for far terrain.
litelights.seed_generation.mismatch_chat: LiteLights stopped predicting far terrain here: the land you visited didn't match it. Check the seed on the Far Terrain page, or the server's world-generation mods.
Asking LiteLights on the server for the seed
litelights.option.far_terrain.seed.helpe: LiteLights on the server doesn't share it with you (%s): enter it below
